issue_context.title: Is 2D CNN's description correct ?
issue_context.body:
>   This layer creates a convolution kernel that is convolved with the layer
    input over a single spatial (or temporal) dimension to produce a tensor of
    outputs. If `use_bias` is True, a bias vector is created and added to the
    outputs. Finally, if `activation` is not `None`, it is applied to the
    outputs as well.

[keras docs](https://github.com/keras-team/keras/blob/v3.4.1/keras/src/layers/convolutional/conv2d.py#L5)

Isn't convolved over *2 spatial dimensions* ?
comments:
Hi @ghsanti - 

Thanks for pointing this issue. We have raised an internal fix for updating the description for 2D and 3D CNN. Soon it will be reflected in the documentation as well. Thanks.

review_comments:
Not an expert but imho this would be more clear for most people:

> This layer creates a kernel that is convolved over the 2D spatial dimensions (height and width) of the input..

Height and width may not even be needed there either.

There are also missing blanks in the **parens** "ension(heigh:" and after **of**  "tensor ofoutputs" which is part of why the linter is failing.

@mehtamansi29
